title: For each term and department, list the term, department, the number of cour
question: For each term and department, list the term, department, the number of courses, average number of equivalent subjects, the school name, and department phone number. Include subtotals for each term (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    ccs.TERM_CODE,
    ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ccs.SUBJECT_ID,
    ccs.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS,
    sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
    sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs
  LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
    ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
    ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
detail AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS num_courses,
    AVG(CASE WHEN EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS IS NOT NULL AND EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS <> ''
             THEN 1 + (LENGTH(EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS) - LENGTH(REPLACE(EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS, ',', '')))
             ELSE 0 END) AS avg_equiv,
    MAX(SCHOOL_NAME) AS school_name,
    MAX(DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) AS dept_phone
  FROM base
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
term_sub AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUM(num_courses) AS num_courses,
    AVG(avg_equiv) AS avg_equiv,
    NULL AS school_name,
    NULL AS dept_phone
  FROM detail
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE
),
grand AS (
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS TERM_CODE,
    'TOTAL' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUM(num_courses) AS num_courses,
    AVG(avg_equiv) AS avg_equiv,
    NULL AS school_name,
    NULL AS dept_phone
  FROM detail
),
all_rows AS (
  SELECT TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, num_courses, avg_equiv, school_name, dept_phone FROM detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, num_courses, avg_equiv, school_name, dept_phone FROM term_sub
  UNION ALL
  SELECT TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, num_courses, avg_equiv, school_name, dept_phone FROM grand
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN TERM_CODE = LAG(TERM_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME)
       THEN '' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS TERM_CODE,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  num_courses,
  avg_equiv,
  school_name,
  dept_phone
FROM all_rows
ORDER BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS term,
    ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS department,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_courses,
    AVG(ccs.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS) AS avg_equiv_subjects,
    MAX(scd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS school_name,
    MAX(sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) AS dept_phone
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs
  LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT
  LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sad.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  GROUP BY ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
rollup_cte AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN GROUPING(term) = 1 AND GROUPING(department) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL'
      WHEN GROUPING(department) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
      ELSE term
    END AS term,
    CASE
      WHEN GROUPING(department) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
      ELSE department
    END AS department,
    SUM(num_courses) AS num_courses,
    AVG(avg_equiv_subjects) AS avg_equiv_subjects,
    MAX(school_name) AS school_name,
    MAX(dept_phone) AS dept_phone
  FROM base
  GROUP BY term, department WITH ROLLUP
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term, department) = term THEN NULL
    ELSE term
  END AS term,
  department,
  num_courses,
  avg_equiv_subjects,
  school_name,
  dept_phone
FROM rollup_cte
ORDER BY term, department

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subcnt, MIN(MEET_TIME) AS mintime, AVG(CASE WHEN equivalent_subjects IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 + LENGTH(equivalent_subjects) - LENGTH(REPLACE(equivalent_subjects, ',', '')) END) AS avgeqisub FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, subcnt, avgeqisub, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, COALESCE(mat.material_count, 0) AS num_required_or_optional_materials FROM inner_cte AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.TERM_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID AND c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') GROUP BY c.TERM_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS mat ON tbltmp.term = mat.TERM_CODE AND tbltmp.dept = mat.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort
